Title: Snowflake Multi-Database
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/snowflake-multi-database
Content: The Solidatus Snowflake Multiple Database Connector is a Java based tool to combine and apply column lineage across multiple Snowflake databases. The connector joins together existing Solidatus Snowflake database models into a single model.
Title: Connector-specific documentation
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation
Content: Java connector SDK
